summary: Frontend-only testing of IBGE 2026 enrollment form auto-selection feature. Verified that /dados-inscricao.html correctly auto-selects all 3 dropdowns: CERTAME='edital_ibge_2026', ESCOLARIDADE='fundamental', VAGA='REC'. The VAGA_DETALHES box is visible and shows 'R$ 70,00'. Confirmed NO old cargos from Porto Velho (AGENTE DE SECRETARIA, AUXILIAR DE FARMÁCIA, PROFESSOR, MÉDICO, ENFERMEIRO, etc.) exist in the page. The concurso.js file was completely rewritten with only 1 edital, 1 escolaridade, 1 cargo (RECENSEADOR at R$70.00). Full enrollment flow tested: /inicio.html -> INSCREVA-SE -> /inscricao-ibge -> INSCREVER-SE -> /termos-concurso -> checkbox + CONTINUAR -> /inscricao.html (personal data form). Note: /inscricao.html is the personal data form without VAGA dropdown; /dados-inscricao.html is the vaga selection form with auto-select.

issues: CSP violation: fetch to /api/track/access blocked by 'default-src none'. Non-blocking for enrollment flow.

critical_code_review_comments: concurso.js correctly implements auto-selection for single-option dropdowns. The code creates CERTAME and ESCOLARIDADE selects dynamically before the existing #VAGA select, then auto-selects all three on page load.
The VAGA dropdown only has 1 option: REC (RECENSEADOR) at R$70.00. All old Porto Velho cargos have been removed.
data-testid attributes are correctly set: select-certame, select-escolaridade, select-vaga, vaga-detalhes
context_for_next_testing_agent: The enrollment flow has two form pages: (1) /inscricao.html for personal data (Nome, CPF, etc.) - no VAGA dropdown, (2) /dados-inscricao.html for vaga selection with auto-select. The auto-selection feature only applies to /dados-inscricao.html where #VAGA element exists. concurso.js creates CERTAME and ESCOLARIDADE selects dynamically when #VAGA is found.
